units.zh: 聖宗四
units.en: Shengzong, Part Four
units.literal: Shengzong, Part Four

units.zh: 八年春正月辛巳，如臺湖。
units.en: In the eighth year of Tonghe, on xinsi day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Taihu.
units.literal: In the eighth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on xinsi day, went to Taihu.

units.zh: 庚寅，詔決滯獄。
units.en: On gengyin day an edict ordered the clearing of backlogged cases.
units.literal: On gengyin day an edict ordered deciding delayed cases.

units.zh: 庚子，如沈子濼。
units.en: On gengzi day the Emperor went to Shenzi Marsh.
units.literal: On gengzi day went to Shenzi Marsh.

units.zh: 二月丁未朔，于闐、回鶻各遣使來貢。
units.en: On the dingwei new moon of the second month Khotan and the Uyghur each sent tribute envoys.
units.literal: In the second month, on the dingwei new moon, Khotan and the Uyghur each dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 壬申，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On renshen day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On renshen day the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 三月丁丑，李繼遷遣使來貢。
units.en: On dingchou day in the third month Li Jiqian of Western Xia sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: In the third month, on dingchou day, Li Jiqian dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 庚辰，太白、熒惑鬥，凡十有五次。
units.en: On gengchen day Venus and Mars came into conjunction fifteen times.
units.literal: On gengchen day Venus and Mars battled, altogether fifteen times.

units.zh: 乙酉，城杏堝，以宋俘實之。
units.en: On yiyou day the court fortified Xingguo and settled it with Song captives.
units.literal: On yiyou day walled Xingguo and filled it with Song captives.

units.zh: 辛丑，置宜州。
units.en: On xinchou day Yi Prefecture was established.
units.literal: On xinchou day Yi Prefecture was established.

units.zh: 夏四月丙午朔，嚴州刺史李壽英有惠政，民請留，從之。
units.en: On the bingwu new moon of the fourth summer month Yan Prefecture prefect Li Shouying had governed well; when the people asked that he stay, the request was granted.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the bingwu new moon, Yan Prefecture prefect Li Shouying had benevolent administration; the people requested he remain; it was granted.

units.zh: 庚戌，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On gengxu day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On gengxu day the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 庚午，以歲旱，諸部艱食，振之。
units.en: On gengwu day, because drought had left the tribes short of food, relief was distributed.
units.literal: On gengwu day because of year drought, the various departments had difficult food; relief was given.

units.zh: 五月戊子，以宋降卒分隸諸軍。
units.en: On wuzi day of the fifth month surrendered Song soldiers were distributed among the various armies.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on wuzi day, Song surrendered soldiers were distributed and assigned to the various armies.

units.zh: 庚寅，女直宰相阿海來貢，封順化王。
units.en: On gengyin day Jurchen chancellor Ahai came with tribute and was enfeoffed Prince of Shunhua.
units.literal: On gengyin day Jurchen chancellor Ahai came with tribute and was enfeoffed Prince of Shunhua.

units.zh: 丙申，清暑胡土白山。
units.en: On bingshen day the court took the summer retreat at Hutu White Mountain.
units.literal: On bingshen day summered for coolness at Hutu White Mountain.

units.zh: 詔括民田。
units.en: An edict ordered a survey of private farmland.
units.literal: An edict ordered surveying private fields.

units.zh: 六月丙午，以北面林牙磨魯古為北院大王。
units.en: On bingwu day of the sixth month Northern Privy Chancellor Morugu was appointed Northern Chancellery Great King.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on bingwu day, Northern Privy Chancellor Morugu was made Northern Chancellery Great King.

units.zh: 阿薩蘭回鶻於越、達剌幹各遣使來貢。
units.en: The Arsalan Uyghur yuyue and dalagan each sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: Arsalan Uyghur yuyue and dalagan each dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 甲寅，月掩天駟第一星。
units.en: On jiayin day the moon passed before the first star of the Celestial Team.
units.literal: On jiayin day the moon occulted the first star of Tiansi.

units.zh: 丙辰，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On bingchen day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On bingchen day the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 秋七月庚辰，改南京熊軍為神軍。
units.en: On gengchen day in the seventh autumn month Nanjing's Bear Army was renamed the Divine Army.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on gengchen day, Nanjing Bear Army was changed to Divine Army.

units.zh: 詔東京路諸宮分提轄司，分置定霸、保和、宣化三縣，白川州置洪理，儀坤州置廣義，遼西州置長慶，乾州置安德各一縣。
units.en: An edict ordered sub-jurisdictions for the Eastern Capital Circuit palace divisions, created Dingba, Baohe, and Xuanhua counties, and added one county each to Baichuan, Yikun, Liaoxi, and Qian prefectures.
units.literal: An edict ordered the Eastern Capital Circuit palace divisions to set up sub-jurisdictions, established Dingba, Baohe, and Xuanhua three counties, and established one county each at Hongli in Baichuan Prefecture, Guangyi in Yikun Prefecture, Changqing in Liaoxi Prefecture, and Ande in Qian Prefecture.

units.zh: 省遂、媯、松、饒、寧、海、瑞、玉、鐵裏、奉德等十州，及玉田、遼豐、松山、弘遠、懷清、雲龍、平澤、平山等八縣，以其民分隸他郡。
units.en: Ten prefectures including Sui, Gui, Song, Rao, Ning, Hai, Rui, Yu, Tieli, and Fengde were abolished, along with eight counties including Yutian, Liaofeng, Songshan, Hongyuan, Huaiqing, Yunlong, Pingze, and Pingshan; their populations were reassigned to other jurisdictions.
units.literal: Suai, Gui, Song, Rao, Ning, Hai, Rui, Yu, Tieli, Fengde, and ten other prefectures were abolished, and Yutian, Liaofeng, Songshan, Hongyuan, Huaiqing, Yunlong, Pingze, Pingshan, and eight other counties were abolished; their people were distributed and assigned to other commanderies.

units.zh: 八月乙卯，以黑白羊祭天地。
units.en: On yimao day of the eighth month the court sacrificed black and white sheep to heaven and earth.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on yimao day, black and white sheep were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 九月乙亥，北女直四部請內附。
units.en: On yihai day of the ninth month the four divisions of the Northern Jurchen asked to submit.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on yihai day, the four divisions of the Northern Jurchen requested internal attachment.

units.zh: 壬辰，李繼遷獻宋俘。
units.en: On renchen day Li Jiqian presented Song captives.
units.literal: On renchen day Li Jiqian presented Song captives.

units.zh: 冬十月丙午，以大敗宋軍，復遣使來告。
units.en: On bingwu day of the tenth winter month, after a great victory over Song forces, envoys were again sent to report the news.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on bingwu day, because of greatly defeating the Song army, envoys were again dispatched to come and report.

units.zh: 己酉，阻卜等遣使來貢。
units.en: On jiyou day the Zubu and others sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On jiyou day the Zubu and others dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 是月，駐蹕大王川。
units.en: That month the court encamped at Dawang River.
units.literal: That month the imperial presence halted at Dawang River.

units.zh: 十一月庚寅，以吐谷渾民饑，振之。
units.en: On gengyin day of the eleventh month, because the Tuyuhun were starving, relief was distributed.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on gengyin day, because the Tuyuhun people were hungry, relief was given.

units.zh: 丁酉，太白晝見。
units.en: On dingyou day Venus was visible in daylight.
units.literal: On dingyou day the Great White Star appeared in daytime.

units.zh: 十二月癸卯，李繼遷下宋麟、鄜等州，遣使來告。
units.en: On guimao day of the twelfth month Li Jiqian captured Song's Lin, Fu, and other prefectures and sent envoys to report.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on guimao day, Li Jiqian took Song Lin, Fu, and other prefectures and dispatched envoys to come and report.

units.zh: 女直遣使來貢。
units.en: The Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: The Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 庚戌，遣使封李繼遷為夏國王。
units.en: On gengxu day envoys were sent to invest Li Jiqian as King of Xia.
units.literal: On gengxu day envoys were dispatched to enfeoff Li Jiqian as King of Xia.

units.zh: 癸丑，回鶻來貢。
units.en: On guichou day the Uyghur came with tribute.
units.literal: On guichou day the Uyghur came with tribute.

units.zh: 是歲，放鄭雲從等二人及第。
units.en: That year Zheng Yuncong and two others passed the examinations.
units.literal: That year Zheng Yuncong and two others were passed and granted degree.

units.zh: 九年春正月甲戌，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: In the ninth year of Tonghe, on jiaxu day of the first spring month, the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on jiaxu day, the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 丙子，詔禁私度僧尼。
units.en: On bingzi day an edict forbade private ordination of monks and nuns.
units.literal: On bingzi day an edict forbade privately ordaining monks and nuns.

units.zh: 庚辰，如臺湖。
units.en: On gengchen day the Emperor went to Taihu.
units.literal: On gengchen day went to Taihu.

units.zh: 乙酉，樞密使、監修國史室昉等進《實錄》，賜物有差。
units.en: On yiyou day Commissioner of Military Affairs and state-history overseer Shi Fang and others presented the Veritable Records, and rewards were granted according to rank.
units.literal: On yiyou day Commissioner of Military Affairs and overseer of the state history Shi Fang and others presented the Veritable Records; gifts were granted in differing amounts.

units.zh: 戊子，選宋降卒五百置為宣力軍。
units.en: On wuzi day five hundred surrendered Song soldiers were organized as the Xuanli Army.
units.literal: On wuzi day five hundred Song surrendered soldiers were selected and established as the Xuanli Army.

units.zh: 辛卯，詔免三京諸道租賦，仍罷括田。
units.en: On xinmao day an edict exempted rent and taxes throughout the three capitals and all circuits and abolished the field survey.
units.literal: On xinmao day an edict exempted rent and taxes of the three capitals and various circuits, and still abolished the field survey.

units.zh: 二月丙午，夏國遣使告伐宋捷。
units.en: On bingwu day of the second month Western Xia sent envoys reporting victory over Song.
units.literal: In the second month, on bingwu day, Xia State dispatched envoys to report victory attacking Song.

units.zh: 丁未，以涿州刺史耶律王六為惕隱。
units.en: On dingwei day Zhuo Prefecture prefect Yelü Wangliu was appointed tiyin.
units.literal: On dingwei day Zhuo Prefecture prefect Yelü Wangliu was made tiyin.

units.zh: 甲子，建威寇、振化、來遠三城，屯戍卒。
units.en: On jiazi day the cities of Weikou, Zhenhua, and Laiyuan were built and garrison troops stationed there.
units.literal: On jiazi day Weikou, Zhenhua, and Laiyuan three cities were built and garrison troops stationed.

units.zh: 閏月辛未朔，日有食之。
units.en: On the xinwei new moon of the intercalary month there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: In the intercalary month, on the xinwei new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 壬申，遣翰林承旨邢抱樸、三司使李嗣、給事中劉京、政事舍人張幹、南京副留守吳浩分決諸道滯獄。
units.en: On renshen day Hanlin Academician Xing Baopu, Three Departments commissioner Li Si, Supervising Secretary Liu Jing, administrative secretary Zhang Gan, and Nanjing vice regent Wu Hao were sent to clear backlogged cases across the circuits.
units.literal: On renshen day Hanlin Academician Xing Baopu, Three Departments commissioner Li Si, supervisory censor Liu Jing, administrative secretary Zhang Gan, and Nanjing vice regent Wu Hao were dispatched to separately decide delayed cases of the various circuits.

units.zh: 三月庚子朔，振室韋、烏古諸部。
units.en: On the gengzi new moon of the third month relief was given to the Shiwei and Wugu tribes.
units.literal: In the third month, on the gengzi new moon, the Shiwei and Wugu tribes were relieved.

units.zh: 戊申，復遣庫部員外郎馬守琪、倉部員外郎祁正、虞部員外郎崔祐、薊北縣令崔簡等分決諸道滯獄。
units.en: On wushen day Ma Shouqi, Qi Zheng, Cui You, Cui Jian, and others were again sent to clear backlogged cases across the circuits.
units.literal: On wushen day Treasury Department outer section member Ma Shouqi, Granary Department outer section member Qi Zheng, Works Department outer section member Cui You, and Jibei county magistrate Cui Jian and others were again dispatched to separately decide delayed cases of the various circuits.

units.zh: 甲子，幸南京。
units.en: On jiazi day the court visited Nanjing.
units.literal: On jiazi day the court favorably visited Nanjing.

units.zh: 夏四月甲戌，回鶻來貢。
units.en: On jiaxu day of the fourth summer month the Uyghur came with tribute.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on jiaxu day, the Uyghur came with tribute.

units.zh: 乙亥，夏國王李繼遷遣杜白來謝封冊。
units.en: On yihai day King of Xia Li Jiqian sent Du Bai to court to thank the court for his investiture.
units.literal: On yihai day King of Xia Li Jiqian dispatched Du Bai to come and thank the enfeoffment patent.

units.zh: 丙戌，清暑炭山。
units.en: On bingxu day the court took the summer retreat at Coal Mountain.
units.literal: On bingxu day summered for coolness at Coal Mountain.

units.zh: 五月己未，以秦王韓匡嗣私城為全州。
units.en: On jiwei day of the fifth month Prince of Qin Han Kuangsi's private fortified town was made Quan Prefecture.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on jiwei day, Qin King Han Kuangsi's private walled city was made Quan Prefecture.

units.zh: 六月丁亥，突厥來貢。
units.en: On dinghai day of the sixth month the Turks came with tribute.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on dinghai day, the Turks came with tribute.

units.zh: 是月，南京霖雨傷稼。
units.en: That month prolonged rain at Nanjing damaged the crops.
units.literal: That month continuous rain at Nanjing damaged the crops.

units.zh: 秋七月癸卯，通括戶口。
units.en: On guimao day in the seventh autumn month a universal household registration was ordered.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on guimao day, household registers were universally surveyed.

units.zh: 乙巳，詔諸道舉才行、察貪酷、撫高年、禁奢僭，有歿於王事者官其子孫。
units.en: On yisi day an edict ordered the circuits to recommend able men, investigate corruption and cruelty, care for the elderly, forbid extravagance and overstepping rank, and appoint the descendants of those who died in state service.
units.literal: On yisi day an edict ordered the various circuits to recommend talent and conduct, investigate greed and cruelty, care for the elderly, forbid extravagance and usurpation, and give office to the sons and grandsons of those who died in royal service.

units.zh: 己未，夏國以復綏、銀二州，遣使來告。
units.en: On jiwei day Western Xia, having recovered Sui and Yin prefectures, sent envoys to report.
units.literal: On jiwei day Xia State, because of recovering Sui and Yin two prefectures, dispatched envoys to come and report.

units.zh: 八月癸酉，銅州嘉禾生，東京甘露降。
units.en: On guiyou day of the eighth month Tong Prefecture produced stalks of auspicious grain and sweet dew fell at the Eastern Capital.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on guiyou day, Tong Prefecture produced auspicious grain, and sweet dew fell at the Eastern Capital.

units.zh: 戊寅，女直進喚鹿人。
units.en: On wuyin day the Jurchen presented deer-callers.
units.literal: On wuyin day the Jurchen presented deer-callers.

units.zh: 壬午，東京進三足烏。
units.en: On renwu day the Eastern Capital presented a three-legged crow.
units.literal: On renwu day the Eastern Capital presented a three-legged crow.

units.zh: 九月庚子，鼻骨德來貢。
units.en: On gengzi day of the ninth month the Bigud came with tribute.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on gengzi day, the Bigud came with tribute.

units.zh: 己酉，駐蹕廟城。
units.en: On jiyou day the court encamped at Miaocheng.
units.literal: On jiyou day the imperial presence halted at Miaocheng.

units.zh: 南京地震。
units.en: Nanjing was shaken by an earthquake.
units.literal: Nanjing had an earthquake.

units.zh: 冬十月丁卯，阿薩蘭回鶻來貢。
units.en: On dingmao day of the tenth winter month Arsalan Uyghur came with tribute.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on dingmao day, Arsalan Uyghur came with tribute.

units.zh: 壬申，夏國王李繼遷遣使來上宋所授敕命。
units.en: On renshen day King of Xia Li Jiqian sent envoys presenting edict commands granted by Song.
units.literal: On renshen day King of Xia Li Jiqian dispatched envoys to come and present Song-granted edict commands.

units.zh: 丁丑，定難軍節度使李繼捧來附，授推忠效順啟聖定難功臣、開府儀同三司、檢校太師兼侍中，封西平王。
units.en: On dingchou day Dingnan Army military commissioner Li Jipeng submitted; he was granted the titles Loyal and Obedient, Effectively Obedient, Initiating Sage, and Pacifier of Dingnan, made Kaifu Yitong Sansi and acting grand preceptor with concurrent palace secretary, and enfeoffed as Western Peace King.
units.literal: On dingchou day Dingnan Army military commissioner Li Jipeng came to attach; he was granted the titles Loyal and Obedient, Effectively Filial, Initiating Sage, and Pacifier of Dingnan, Kaifu Yitong Sansi, acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Palace Secretary, and enfeoffed Western Peace King.

units.zh: 十一月己亥，以青牛白馬祭天地。
units.en: On jihai day of the eleventh month the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on jihai day, a green ox and white horse were used to sacrifice to heaven and earth.

units.zh: 十二月，夏國王李繼遷潛附於宋，遣招討使韓德威持詔諭之。
units.en: In the twelfth month King of Xia Li Jiqian secretly renewed ties with Song, and pacification commissioner Han Dewei was sent with an edict to rebuke him.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, King of Xia Li Jiqian secretly attached to Song; pacification commissioner Han Dewei was dispatched to hold an edict and instruct him.

units.zh: 是歲，放進士石用中一人及第。
units.en: That year jinshi Shi Yongzhong alone passed the examinations.
units.literal: That year jinshi Shi Yongzhong alone was passed and granted degree.

units.zh: 十年春正月丁酉，禁喪葬禮殺馬，及藏甲胄、金銀、器玩。
units.en: In the tenth year of Tonghe, on dingyou day of the first spring month, an edict forbade killing horses at funerals and hoarding armor, gold and silver, and luxury goods.
units.literal: In the tenth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on dingyou day, killing horses in funeral rites was forbidden, as was storing armor, gold and silver, and curios.

units.zh: 丙午，如臺湖。
units.en: On bingwu day the Emperor went to Taihu.
units.literal: On bingwu day went to Taihu.

units.zh: 二月乙丑朔，日有食之。
units.en: On the yichou new moon of the second month there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: In the second month, on the yichou new moon, there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 韓德威奏李繼遷稱故不出，至靈州俘掠以還。
units.en: Han Dewei reported that Li Jiqian pleaded illness and refused to appear, raided Ling Prefecture for captives and plunder, and then withdrew.
units.literal: Han Dewei memorialized that Li Jiqian claimed illness and did not come out, reached Ling Prefecture taking captives and plundering, then returned.

units.zh: 壬申，兀惹來貢。
units.en: On renshen day the Wu'er came with tribute.
units.literal: On renshen day the Wu'er came with tribute.

units.zh: 壬午，免雲州租賦。
units.en: On renwu day rent and taxes at Yun Prefecture were remitted.
units.literal: On renwu day Yun Prefecture's rent and taxes were exempted.

units.zh: 庚寅，夏國以韓德威俘掠，遣使來奏，賜詔安慰。
units.en: On gengyin day Western Xia, protesting Han Dewei's raids, sent envoys to court; a comforting edict was issued in reply.
units.literal: On gengyin day Xia State, because Han Dewei took captives and plundered, dispatched envoys to report; an edict was granted to comfort them.

units.zh: 辛卯，給復雲州流民。
units.en: On xinmao day relief was granted to displaced persons in Yun Prefecture.
units.literal: On xinmao day displaced persons of Yun Prefecture were granted relief.

units.zh: 三月甲辰，鐵驪來貢。
units.en: On jiachen day of the third month the Iron Li came with tribute.
units.literal: In the third month, on jiachen day, the Iron Li came with tribute.

units.zh: 丙辰，如炭山。
units.en: On bingchen day the Emperor went to Coal Mountain.
units.literal: On bingchen day went to Coal Mountain.

units.zh: 夏四月乙丑，以臺湖為望幸裏。
units.en: On yichou day of the fourth summer month Taihu was designated an imperial visitation district.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, on yichou day, Taihu was made a district of imperial visits.

units.zh: 庚寅，命群臣較射。
units.en: On gengyin day the court held an archery contest for the ministers.
units.literal: On gengyin day the hundred officials were ordered to compete in archery.

units.zh: 五月癸巳，朔州流民給復三年。
units.en: On guisi day of the fifth month displaced persons in Shuo Prefecture were granted three years' relief.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on guisi day, displaced persons of Shuo Prefecture were granted relief for three years.

units.zh: 七月辛酉，鐵驪來貢。
units.en: On xinyou day of the seventh month the Iron Li came with tribute.
units.literal: In the seventh month, on xinyou day, the Iron Li came with tribute.

units.zh: 八月癸亥，觀稼，仍遣使分閱苗稼。
units.en: On guihai day of the eighth month the court inspected the crops and sent envoys to review the fields district by district.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on guihai day, the crops were viewed, and envoys were still dispatched to separately inspect the seedling crops.

units.zh: 九月癸卯，幸五臺山金河寺飯僧。
units.en: On guimao day of the ninth month the court visited Jinhe Temple on Wutai Mountain and feasted the monks.
units.literal: In the ninth month, on guimao day, the court favorably visited Wutai Mountain Jinhe Temple to feed the monks.

units.zh: 冬十月壬申，夏國王遣使來貢。
units.en: On renshen day of the tenth winter month the King of Xia sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: In winter, tenth month, on renshen day, the King of Xia dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 戊寅，鐵驪來貢。
units.en: On wuyin day the Iron Li came with tribute.
units.literal: On wuyin day the Iron Li came with tribute.

units.zh: 十一月壬辰，回鶻來貢。
units.en: On renchen day of the eleventh month the Uyghur came with tribute.
units.literal: In the eleventh month, on renchen day, the Uyghur came with tribute.

units.zh: 十二月庚辰，獵儒州東川。
units.en: On gengchen day of the twelfth month the court hunted at Ruzhou East River.
units.literal: In the twelfth month, on gengchen day, hunted at Ruzhou East River.

units.zh: 拜天。
units.en: The court performed heaven worship.
units.literal: Heaven was worshipped.

units.zh: 是月，以東京留守蕭恒德等伐高麗。
units.en: That month Eastern Capital regent Xiao Hengde and others were sent to attack Goryeo.
units.literal: That month Eastern Capital regent Xiao Hengde and others attacked Goryeo.

units.zh: 十一年春正月壬寅，回鶻來貢。
units.en: In the eleventh year of Tonghe, on renyin day of the first spring month, the Uyghur came with tribute.
units.literal: In the eleventh year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on renyin day, the Uyghur came with tribute.

units.zh: 丙午，出內帑錢賜南京統軍司軍。
units.en: On bingwu day money from the inner treasury was distributed to the armies of the Nanjing military command.
units.literal: On bingwu day inner treasury money was disbursed and granted to the armies of the Nanjing military command.

units.zh: 高麗王治遣樸良柔奉表請罪，詔取女直鴨淥江東數百里地賜之。
units.en: Goryeo King Wang Zhi sent Park Yangrou with a memorial begging pardon; an edict ceded several hundred li of Jurchen territory east of the Yalu River to Goryeo.
units.literal: Goryeo King Wang Zhi dispatched Park Yangrou with a memorial requesting pardon; an edict took several hundred li of Jurchen land east of the Yalu River and granted it to them.

units.zh: 二月癸亥，霸州民妻王氏以妖惑眾，伏誅。
units.en: On guihai day of the second month Lady Wang, a commoner's wife of Bazhou, was executed for sorcery that misled the people.
units.literal: In the second month, on guihai day, Bazhou commoner's wife Lady Wang, because of demonic delusion of the multitude, was executed.

units.zh: 夏四月，幸炭山清暑。
units.en: In the fourth summer month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
units.literal: In summer, fourth month, the court favorably visited Coal Mountain for coolness.

units.zh: 六月，大雨。
units.en: In the sixth month heavy rains fell.
units.literal: In the sixth month there was great rain.

units.zh: 秋七月己丑，桑乾、羊河溢居庸關西，害禾稼殆盡，奉聖、南京居民廬舍多墊溺者。
units.en: On jichou day in the seventh autumn month the Sanggan and Yang Rivers overflowed west of Juyong Pass and nearly destroyed the grain crop; many homes in Fengsheng and Nanjing were flooded.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jichou day the Sanggan and Yang Rivers overflowed west of Juyong Pass, nearly destroying the grain crop; many dwellings of residents of Fengsheng and Nanjing were inundated.

units.zh: 八月，如秋山。
units.en: In the eighth month the court went to Autumn Mountain.
units.literal: In the eighth month the court went to Autumn Mountain.

units.zh: 冬十月甲申朔，駐蹕蒲瑰阪。
units.en: On the jiashen new moon of the tenth winter month the court halted at Pugui Slope.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on the jiashen new moon the court halted at Pugui Slope.

units.zh: 是歲，放進士王熙載等二人及第。
units.en: That year jinshi Wang Xizai and one other passed the examinations.
units.literal: That year jinshi Wang Xizai and one other were passed and granted degree.

units.zh: 十二年春正月癸丑朔，漷陰鎮水，漂溺三十餘村，詔疏舊渠。
units.en: On the guichou new moon of the first spring month in the twelfth year, flooding at Huoyin Town drowned more than thirty villages, and an edict ordered the old canal dredged.
units.literal: In the twelfth year, spring, first month, on the guichou new moon waters at Huoyin Town flooded and drowned more than thirty villages; an edict ordered the old canal dredged.

units.zh: 甲寅，以同政事門下平章事耶律碩老為惕隱。
units.en: On jiayin day co-chancellor of the Secretariat Yelü Shuolao was appointed tiyin.
units.literal: On jiayin day co-chancellor of the Secretariat Yelü Shuolao was made tiyin.

units.zh: 詔復行在五十里內租。
units.en: An edict restored land tax within fifty li of the traveling palace.
units.literal: An edict restored land tax within fifty li of the traveling palace.

units.zh: 乙卯，幸延芳澱。
units.en: On yimao day the court visited Yanfang Marsh.
units.literal: On yimao day the court visited Yanfang Marsh.

units.zh: 戊午，蠲宜州賦調。
units.en: On wuwu day Yi Prefecture's tax and corvée were remitted.
units.literal: On wuwu day Yi Prefecture's tax and corvée were remitted.

units.zh: 庚申，郎君耶律鼻舍等謀叛，伏誅。
units.en: On gengshen day langjun Yelü Bise and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
units.literal: On gengshen day langjun Yelü Bise and others plotted rebellion and were executed.

units.zh: 壬戌，以南院大王耶律景為上京留守，封漆水郡王。
units.en: On renxu day Southern Court Great King Yelü Jing was appointed Shangjing regent and enfeoffed Commandery Prince of Qishui.
units.literal: On renxu day Southern Court Great King Yelü Jing was made Shangjing regent and enfeoffed Commandery Prince of Qishui.

units.zh: 霸州民李在宥年百三十有三，賜束帛、錦袍、銀帶，月給羊酒，仍復其家。
units.en: Li Zaiyou, a commoner of Bazhou aged one hundred thirty-three, was granted silk, a brocade robe, and a silver belt, given monthly rations of mutton and wine, and his household was exempted from service.
units.literal: Li Zaiyou of Bazhou, a commoner aged one hundred thirty-three, was granted silk, a brocade robe, and a silver belt, given monthly rations of mutton and wine, and his household was exempted from service.

units.zh: 二月甲申，免南京被水戶租賦。
units.en: On jiashen day of the second month rent and tax were remitted for Nanjing households affected by flood.
units.literal: Second month, on jiashen day rent and tax were remitted for Nanjing households affected by flood.

units.zh: 己丑，高麗來貢。
units.en: On jichou day Goryeo came with tribute.
units.literal: On jichou day Goryeo came with tribute.

units.zh: 甲午，免諸部歲輸羊及關征。
units.en: On jiawu day the yearly tribute of sheep from the various tribes and border transit levies were remitted.
units.literal: On jiawu day the yearly tribute of sheep from the various tribes and border transit levies were remitted.

units.zh: 庚子，回鶻來貢。
units.en: On gengzi day the Uyghur came with tribute.
units.literal: On gengzi day the Uyghur came with tribute.

units.zh: 三月丁巳，高麗遣使請所俘人畜，詔贖還。
units.en: On dingsi day of the third month Goryeo sent envoys asking for the return of captives and livestock, and an edict ordered them ransomed and returned.
units.literal: Third month, on dingsi day Goryeo sent envoys requesting the return of captives and livestock; an edict ordered them ransomed and returned.

units.zh: 戊午，幸南京。
units.en: On wuwu day the court visited Nanjing.
units.literal: On wuwu day the court visited Nanjing.

units.zh: 丙寅，遣使撫諭高麗。
units.en: On bingyin day envoys were sent to comfort and instruct Goryeo.
units.literal: On bingyin day envoys were dispatched to comfort and instruct Goryeo.

units.zh: 己巳，涿州木連理。
units.en: On jisi day linked trees appeared in Zhuo Prefecture.
units.literal: On jisi day linked trees appeared in Zhuo Prefecture.

units.zh: 壬申，如長春宮觀牡丹。
units.en: On renshen day the court went to Changchun Palace to view the peonies.
units.literal: On renshen day the court went to Changchun Palace to view the peonies.

units.zh: 是月，復置南京軍都監。
units.en: That month the Nanjing army superintendent was restored.
units.literal: That month the Nanjing army superintendent was restored.

units.zh: 夏四月辛卯，幸南京。
units.en: On xinmao day of the fourth summer month the court visited Nanjing.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on xinmao day the court visited Nanjing.

units.zh: 壬辰，樞密直學士劉恕為南院樞密副使。
units.en: On renchen day Pivot Academy academician Liu Shu was appointed Southern Court deputy commissioner of military affairs.
units.literal: On renchen day Pivot Academy academician Liu Shu was made Southern Court deputy commissioner of military affairs.

units.zh: 戊戌，以景宗石像成，幸延壽寺飯僧。
units.en: On wuxu day, because the stone image of Emperor Jingzong was completed, the court visited Yanshou Temple and fed the monks.
units.literal: On wuxu day, because the stone image of Emperor Jingzong was completed, the court visited Yanshou Temple and fed the monks.

units.zh: 五月甲寅，詔北皮室軍老不任事者免役。
units.en: On jiayin day of the fifth month an edict ordered that aged men of the Northern Pishi Army unfit for duty be exempted from service.
units.literal: Fifth month, on jiayin day an edict ordered that aged men of the Northern Pishi Army unfit for duty be exempted from service.

units.zh: 戊午，如炭山清暑。
units.en: On wuwu day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
units.literal: On wuwu day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

units.zh: 庚辰，武定軍節度使韓德沖秩滿，其民請留，從之。
units.en: On gengchen day Wuding Army military commissioner Han Dechong's term expired; when the people asked that he stay, the request was granted.
units.literal: On gengchen day Wuding Army military commissioner Han Dechong's term expired; the people requested he remain; it was granted.

units.zh: 六月辛巳朔，詔州縣長吏有才能無過者，減一資考任之。
units.en: On the xinsi new moon of the sixth month an edict ordered that prefectural and county chief officials who had ability and no faults be appointed with one rank of seniority deducted from their evaluation.
units.literal: Sixth month, on xinsi new moon: an edict ordered that prefectural and county chief officials who had ability and no faults have one rank of seniority deducted in their evaluation for appointment.

units.zh: 癸未，可汗州刺史賈俊進新歷。
units.en: On guiwei day Kehan Prefecture prefect Jia Jun presented a new calendar.
units.literal: On guiwei day Kehan Prefecture prefect Jia Jun presented a new calendar.

units.zh: 庚子，錄囚。
units.en: On gengzi day prisoners were reviewed.
units.literal: On gengzi day prisoners were reviewed.

units.zh: 甲辰，詔龍、鳳兩軍老疾者代之。
units.en: On jiachen day an edict ordered that aged and sick men of the Dragon and Phoenix armies be replaced.
units.literal: On jiachen day an edict ordered that aged and sick men of the Dragon and Phoenix armies be replaced.

units.zh: 是月，太白、歲星相犯。
units.en: That month Venus and Jupiter crossed one another.
units.literal: That month Venus and Jupiter crossed one another.

units.zh: 秋七月辛亥朔，日有食之。
units.en: On the xinhai new moon of the seventh autumn month there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the xinhai new moon there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 甲寅，遣使視諸道禾稼。
units.en: On jiayin day envoys were sent to inspect the grain crops of the various circuits.
units.literal: On jiayin day envoys were dispatched to inspect the grain crops of the various circuits.

units.zh: 辛酉，南院樞密使室昉為中京留守，加尚父。
units.en: On xinyou day Southern Court commissioner of military affairs Shi Fang was appointed Zhongjing regent and given the honorific Shangfu.
units.literal: On xinyou day Southern Court commissioner of military affairs Shi Fang was made Zhongjing regent and given the honorific Shangfu.

units.zh: 丙寅，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On bingyin day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On bingyin day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 戊辰，觀獲。
units.en: On wuchen day the court inspected the harvest.
units.literal: On wuchen day the harvest was inspected.

units.zh: 庚午，詔契丹人犯十惡者依漢律。
units.en: On gengwu day an edict ordered that Khitan who committed the ten abominations be judged under Han law.
units.literal: On gengwu day an edict ordered that Khitan who committed the ten abominations be judged by Han law.

units.zh: 己卯，以翰林承旨邢抱樸參知政事。
units.en: On jimao day Hanlin Academician Recipient of Edicts Xing Baopu was appointed associate state counselor.
units.literal: On jimao day Hanlin Academician Recipient of Edicts Xing Baopu was made associate state counselor.

units.zh: 八月庚辰朔，詔皇太妃領西北路烏古等部兵及永興宮分軍，撫定西邊；
units.en: On the gengchen new moon of the eighth month an edict ordered the Grand Imperial Consort to lead Northwestern Road Ugu and other tribal troops and the Yongxing palace division army to pacify the western frontier;
units.literal: Eighth month, on the gengchen new moon: an edict ordered the Grand Imperial Consort to lead troops of the Northwestern Road Ugu and other tribes and the Yongxing palace division army to pacify the western frontier;

units.zh: 以蕭撻凜督其軍事。
units.en: Xiao Talin was put in charge of their military affairs.
units.literal: Xiao Talin was put in charge of their military affairs.

units.zh: 乙酉，宋遣使求和，不許。
units.en: On yiyou day Song sent envoys seeking peace, and the request was refused.
units.literal: On yiyou day Song sent envoys seeking peace; it was not granted.

units.zh: 戊子，以國舅帳克蕭徒骨為夷離畢。
units.en: On wuzi day Imperial Uncle Tent Ke Xiao Tugu was appointed yilibi.
units.literal: On wuzi day Imperial Uncle Tent Ke Xiao Tugu was made yilibi.

units.zh: 乙未，下詔戒諭中外官吏。
units.en: On yiwei day an edict was issued admonishing officials within and outside the court.
units.literal: On yiwei day an edict was issued admonishing officials within and without the court.

units.zh: 丁酉，錄囚，雜犯死罪以下釋之。
units.en: On dingyou day prisoners were reviewed, and those guilty of miscellaneous offenses below capital crime were released.
units.literal: On dingyou day prisoners were reviewed, and those guilty of miscellaneous offenses below capital crime were released.

units.zh: 九月壬子，室韋、党項、吐谷渾等來貢。
units.en: On renzi day of the ninth month the Shiwei, Tangut, Tuhun, and others came with tribute.
units.literal: Ninth month, on renzi day the Shiwei, Tangut, Tuhun, and others came with tribute.

units.zh: 辛酉，宋復遣使求和，不許。
units.en: On xinyou day Song again sent envoys seeking peace, and the request was refused.
units.literal: On xinyou day Song again sent envoys seeking peace; it was not granted.

units.zh: 壬戌，行拜奧禮。
units.en: On renxu day the worship-of-ao rite was performed.
units.literal: On renxu day the worship-of-ao rite was performed.

units.zh: 癸酉，阻卜等來貢。
units.en: On guiyou day the Zubu and others came with tribute.
units.literal: On guiyou day the Zubu and others came with tribute.

units.zh: 冬十月乙酉，獵可汗州之西山。
units.en: On yiyou day of the tenth winter month the court hunted in the western hills of Kehan Prefecture.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yiyou day the court hunted in the western hills of Kehan Prefecture.

units.zh: 乙巳，詔定均稅法。
units.en: On yisi day an edict fixed the uniform-tax law.
units.literal: On yisi day an edict fixed the uniform-tax law.

units.zh: 丁未，大理寺置少卿及正。
units.en: On dingwei day the Court of Judicial Review was given a vice director and a chief.
units.literal: On dingwei day the Court of Judicial Review was given a vice director and a chief.

units.zh: 十一月戊申朔，行再生禮。
units.en: On the wushen new moon of the eleventh month the rebirth rite was performed.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on the wushen new moon the rebirth rite was performed.

units.zh: 鐵驪來貢。
units.en: The Iron Li came with tribute.
units.literal: The Iron Li came with tribute.

units.zh: 詔諸部所俘宋人有官吏儒生抱器能者，諸道軍有勇健者，具以名聞。
units.en: An edict ordered that Song captives taken by the various tribes who were officials, scholars, or skilled men, and brave and strong men in the circuit armies, all be reported by name.
units.literal: An edict ordered that Song captives taken by the various tribes who were officials, scholars, or men of skill, and brave and strong men in the circuit armies, all be reported by name.

units.zh: 庚戌，詔郡邑貢明經、茂材異等。
units.en: On gengxu day an edict ordered the commanderies and districts to present men learned in the classics and men of outstanding talent.
units.literal: On gengxu day an edict ordered the commanderies and districts to present men learned in the classics and men of outstanding talent.

units.zh: 甲寅，詔南京決滯獄。
units.en: On jiayin day an edict ordered delayed cases decided at Nanjing.
units.literal: On jiayin day an edict ordered delayed cases decided at Nanjing.

units.zh: 己未，官宋俘衛德升等六人。
units.en: On jiwei day six Song captives including Wei Desheng were given office.
units.literal: On jiwei day six Song captives including Wei Desheng were given office.

units.zh: 十二月戊寅朔，日有食之。
units.en: On the wuyin new moon of the twelfth month there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on the wuyin new moon there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 詔並奚王府奧理、墮隗、梅只三部為一，其二克各分為部，以足六部之數。
units.en: An edict ordered the Xi princely house's Aoli, Duowei, and Meizhi three divisions merged into one, and each of the two ke divided into divisions to make up six divisions.
units.literal: An edict ordered the Xi princely house's Aoli, Duowei, and Meizhi three divisions merged into one, and each of the two ke divided into divisions so as to make up the number of six divisions.

units.zh: 甲申，賜南京統軍司貧戶耕牛。
units.en: On jiashen day plow oxen were granted to poor households of the Nanjing military command.
units.literal: On jiashen day plow oxen were granted to poor households of the Nanjing military command.

units.zh: 戊子，高麗進妓樂，卻之。
units.en: On wuzi day Goryeo presented singing girls and musicians, and they were declined.
units.literal: On wuzi day Goryeo presented singing girls and musicians; they were declined.

units.zh: 庚寅，禁遊食民。
units.en: On gengyin day vagrant laborers were forbidden.
units.literal: On gengyin day vagrant laborers were forbidden.

units.zh: 癸巳，女直以宋人浮海賂本國及兀惹叛來告。
units.en: On guisi day the Jurchen reported that Song men had crossed the sea to bribe their state and that the Wu'er had rebelled.
units.literal: On guisi day the Jurchen reported that Song men had crossed the sea to bribe their state and that the Wu'er had rebelled.

units.zh: 丁未，幸南京。
units.en: On dingwei day the court visited Nanjing.
units.literal: On dingwei day the court visited Nanjing.

units.zh: 是年，放進士呂德懋等二人及第。
units.en: That year jinshi Lü Demao and one other passed the examinations.
units.literal: That year jinshi Lü Demao and one other were passed and granted degree.

units.zh: 十三年春正月壬子，幸延芳澱。
units.en: In the thirteenth year, on renzi day of the first spring month, the court visited Yanfang Marsh.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year, spring, first month, on renzi day the court visited Yanfang Marsh.

units.zh: 甲寅，置廣靈縣。
units.en: On jiayin day Guangling County was established.
units.literal: On jiayin day Guangling County was established.

units.zh: 丁巳，增泰州、遂城等縣賦。
units.en: On dingsi day the tax levies of Taizhou, Suicheng, and other counties were increased.
units.literal: On dingsi day the tax levies of Taizhou, Suicheng, and other counties were increased.

units.zh: 庚申，詔諸道勸農。
units.en: On gengshen day an edict ordered the various circuits to encourage agriculture.
units.literal: On gengshen day an edict ordered the various circuits to encourage agriculture.

units.zh: 癸亥，長寧軍節度使蕭解裏秩滿，民請留，從之。
units.en: On guihai day Changning Army military commissioner Xiao Jieli's term expired; when the people asked that he stay, the request was granted.
units.literal: On guihai day Changning Army military commissioner Xiao Jieli's term expired; the people requested he remain; it was granted.

units.zh: 庚午，如長春宮。
units.en: On gengwu day the court went to Changchun Palace.
units.literal: On gengwu day the court went to Changchun Palace.

units.zh: 三月丁丑朔，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On the dingchou new moon of the third month the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: Third month, on the dingchou new moon the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 甲辰，高麗遣李周楨來貢。
units.en: On jiachen day Goryeo sent Li Zhouzhen with tribute.
units.literal: On jiachen day Goryeo sent Li Zhouzhen with tribute.

units.zh: 三月癸丑，夏國遣使來貢。
units.en: On guichou day of the third month Western Xia sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: Third month, on guichou day Western Xia sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 戊辰，武清縣百餘人入宋境剽掠，命誅之，還其所獲人畜財物。
units.en: On wuchen day more than a hundred men of Wuqing County entered Song territory to plunder; an edict ordered them executed and the people, livestock, and goods they had seized returned.
units.literal: On wuchen day more than a hundred men of Wuqing County entered Song territory to plunder; an edict ordered them executed and what they had seized in people, livestock, and goods returned.

units.zh: 夏四月己卯，參知政事邢抱樸以母憂去官，起復。
units.en: On jimao day of the fourth summer month associate state counselor Xing Baopu left office to mourn his mother and was recalled to service.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jimao day associate state counselor Xing Baopu left office on account of mourning for his mother and was recalled to service.

units.zh: 丙戌，詔諸道民戶應歷以來脅從為部曲者，仍籍州縣。
units.en: On bingxu day an edict ordered that common households of the various circuits who since the Yingli reign had been coerced into becoming retainers be registered again with prefectures and counties.
units.literal: On bingxu day an edict ordered that common households of the various circuits who since the Yingli reign had been coerced into becoming retainers should again be registered with prefectures and counties.

units.zh: 甲午，如炭山清暑。
units.en: On jiawu day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
units.literal: On jiawu day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

units.zh: 五月壬子，高麗進鷹。
units.en: On renzi day of the fifth month Goryeo presented hawks.
units.literal: Fifth month, on renzi day Goryeo presented hawks.

units.zh: 乙亥，北、南、乙室三府請括富民馬以備軍需，不許，給以官馬。
units.en: On yihai day the Northern, Southern, and Yishi Three Offices asked to requisition rich households' horses for military needs; the request was refused and official horses were supplied instead.
units.literal: On yihai day the Northern, Southern, and Yishi Three Offices requested that rich households' horses be requisitioned for military needs; it was not granted, and official horses were supplied instead.

units.zh: 六月丙子朔，啟聖軍節度使劉繼琛秩滿，民請留，從之。
units.en: On the bingzi new moon of the sixth month Qisheng Army military commissioner Liu Jichen's term expired; when the people asked that he stay, the request was granted.
units.literal: Sixth month, on the bingzi new moon Qisheng Army military commissioner Liu Jichen's term expired; the people requested he remain; it was granted.

units.zh: 丁丑，詔減前歲括田租賦。
units.en: On dingchou day an edict reduced the land-tax rent and levies from the previous year's field survey.
units.literal: On dingchou day an edict reduced the land-tax rent and levies of the previous year's field survey.

units.zh: 甲申，以宣徽使阿沒裏私城為豐州。
units.en: On jiashen day the private walled town of Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Amoli was made Feng Prefecture.
units.literal: On jiashen day the private walled town of Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Amoli was made Feng Prefecture.

units.zh: 丙戌，詔許昌平、懷柔等縣諸人請業荒地。
units.en: On bingxu day an edict permitted people of Changping, Huairou, and other counties to claim wasteland for farming.
units.literal: On bingxu day an edict permitted people of Changping, Huairou, and other counties to claim wasteland for farming.

units.zh: 秋七月乙巳朔，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On the yisi new moon of the seventh autumn month the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on the yisi new moon the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 丁巳，兀惹烏昭度、渤海燕頗等侵鐵驪，遣奚王和朔奴等討之。
units.en: On dingsi day the Wu'er Wuzhaodu, Bohai Yanpo, and others invaded the Iron Li, and Xi King Heshuonu and others were dispatched to attack them.
units.literal: On dingsi day the Wu'er Wuzhaodu, Bohai Yanpo, and others invaded the Iron Li; Xi King Heshuonu and others were dispatched to attack them.

units.zh: 壬戌，詔蔚、朔等州龍衛、威勝軍更戍。
units.en: On renxu day an edict ordered the Dragon Guard and Weisheng Army of Yu and Shuo prefectures to rotate garrison duty.
units.literal: On renxu day an edict ordered the Dragon Guard and Weisheng Army of Yu and Shuo prefectures to rotate garrison duty.

units.zh: 八月丙子，夏國遣使進馬。
units.en: On bingzi day of the eighth month Western Xia sent envoys presenting horses.
units.literal: Eighth month, on bingzi day Western Xia sent envoys presenting horses.

units.zh: 壬辰，詔修山澤祠宇、先哲廟貌，以時祀之。
units.en: On renchen day an edict ordered mountain and river shrines and temples of former sages repaired and sacrifices performed at the proper seasons.
units.literal: On renchen day an edict ordered mountain and river shrines and temples of former sages repaired and sacrifices performed at the proper seasons.

units.zh: 九月戊午，以南京太學生員浸多，特賜水硙莊一區。
units.en: On wuwu day of the ninth month, because Nanjing National University students had grown numerous, a watermill estate was specially granted.
units.literal: Ninth month, on wuwu day, because Nanjing National University students had grown numerous, a watermill estate was specially granted.

units.zh: 丁卯，奉安景宗及皇太后石像於延芳澱。
units.en: On dingmao day the stone images of Emperor Jingzong and the Empress Dowager were installed at Yanfang Marsh.
units.literal: On dingmao day the stone images of Emperor Jingzong and the Empress Dowager were installed at Yanfang Marsh.

units.zh: 冬十月乙亥，置義倉。
units.en: On yihai day of the tenth winter month charity granaries were established.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on yihai day charity granaries were established.

units.zh: 辛巳，回鶻來貢。
units.en: On xinsi day the Uyghur came with tribute.
units.literal: On xinsi day the Uyghur came with tribute.

units.zh: 甲申，高麗遣李知白來貢。
units.en: On jiashen day Goryeo sent Li Zhibai with tribute.
units.literal: On jiashen day Goryeo sent Li Zhibai with tribute.

units.zh: 戊子，兀惹歸款，詔諭之。
units.en: On wuzi day the Wu'er submitted, and an edict instructed them.
units.literal: On wuzi day the Wu'er submitted; an edict instructed them.

units.zh: 庚子，鼻骨德來貢。
units.en: On gengzi day the Bigud came with tribute.
units.literal: On gengzi day the Bigud came with tribute.

units.zh: 十一月乙巳，阿薩蘭回鶻遣使來貢。
units.en: On yisi day of the eleventh month Arsalan Uyghur sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on yisi day Arsalan Uyghur sent envoys with tribute.

units.zh: 辛酉，遣使冊王治為高麗國王。
units.en: On xinyou day envoys were sent to invest Wang Zhi as King of Goryeo.
units.literal: On xinyou day envoys were dispatched to invest Wang Zhi as King of Goryeo.

units.zh: 戊辰，高麗遣童子十人來學本國語。
units.en: On wuchen day Goryeo sent ten youths to study the Khitan language.
units.literal: On wuchen day Goryeo dispatched ten youths to come study the native language.

units.zh: 十二月己卯，鐵驪遣使來貢鷹、馬。
units.en: On jimao day in the twelfth month the Iron Li sent envoys with tribute of hawks and horses.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on jimao day the Iron Li dispatched envoys to come with tribute of hawks and horses.

units.zh: 辛巳，夏國以敗宋人遣使來告。
units.en: On xinsi day Western Xia sent envoys to report its victory over Song troops.
units.literal: On xinsi day Western Xia, because it had defeated Song troops, dispatched envoys to come report.

units.zh: 是年，放進士王用極等二人。
units.en: That year jinshi Wang Yongji and one other passed the examinations.
units.literal: That year jinshi Wang Yongji and one other were passed and granted degree.

units.zh: 十四年春正月己酉，漁於潞河。
units.en: In the fourteenth year, on jiyou day in the first spring month, the court went fishing on the Lu River.
units.literal: Fourteenth year, spring, first month, on jiyou day fished on the Lu River.

units.zh: 丁巳，蠲三京及諸州稅賦。
units.en: On dingsi day an edict remitted taxes and levies in the three capitals and the various prefectures.
units.literal: On dingsi day remitted tax and levies of the three capitals and the various prefectures.

units.zh: 丙寅，夏國遣使來貢。
units.en: On bingyin day Western Xia sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On bingyin day Western Xia dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 庚午，以宣徽使阿沒裏家奴閻貴為豐州刺史。
units.en: On gengwu day Yan Gui, a household slave of palace attendant Amoli, was appointed prefect of Feng Prefecture.
units.literal: On gengwu day household slave Yan Gui of Palace Attendant Amoli was made prefect of Feng Prefecture.

units.zh: 二月庚寅，回鶻遣使來貢。
units.en: On gengyin day in the second month the Uyghur sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: Second month, on gengyin day the Uyghur dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 三月壬寅，高麗王治表乞為婚，許以東京留守、駙馬蕭恒德女嫁之。
units.en: On renyin day in the third month Goryeo King Wang Zhi asked to marry; the court agreed to give him the daughter of Eastern Capital regent and imperial son-in-law Xiao Hengde.
units.literal: Third month, on renyin day Goryeo King Wang Zhi memorialized begging for marriage; it was granted that the daughter of Eastern Capital regent and imperial son-in-law Xiao Hengde be given in marriage to him.

units.zh: 庚戌，高麗復遣童子十人來學本國語。
units.en: On gengxu day Goryeo again sent ten youths to study the Khitan language.
units.literal: On gengxu day Goryeo again dispatched ten youths to come study the native language.

units.zh: 甲寅，韓德威奏討党項捷。
units.en: On jiayin day Han Dewei reported victory over the Tangut.
units.literal: On jiayin day Han Dewei memorialized victory in campaigning against the Tangut.

units.zh: 甲子，詔安集朔州流民。
units.en: On jiazi day an edict ordered resettlement and relief for displaced people in Shuo Prefecture.
units.literal: On jiazi day an edict ordered resettlement and pacification of displaced people of Shuo Prefecture.

units.zh: 夏四月甲戌，東邊諸糺各置都監。
units.en: On jiaxu day in the fourth summer month each eastern tribe was given its own overseer.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiaxu day each of the eastern tribes was given its own overseer.

units.zh: 庚寅，如炭山清暑。
units.en: On gengyin day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
units.literal: On gengyin day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

units.zh: 己亥，鑿大安山，取劉守光所藏錢。
units.en: On jihai day Mount Da'an was excavated and the treasure Liu Shouguang had hidden there was recovered.
units.literal: On jihai day Mount Da'an was excavated and the money Liu Shouguang had hidden was taken.

units.zh: 是月，奚王和朔奴、東京留守蕭恒德等五人以討兀惹不克，削官。
units.en: That month Xi King Heshuonu, Eastern Capital regent Xiao Hengde, and three others were demoted for failing to subdue the Wu'er.
units.literal: That month, Xi King Heshuonu, Eastern Capital regent Xiao Hengde, and three others, because they had failed to subdue the Wu'er, had their offices reduced.

units.zh: 改諸部令穩為節度使。
units.en: The various tribes' lingwen posts were converted to military commissioner posts.
units.literal: The various tribes' lingwen were changed to military commissioners.

units.zh: 五月癸卯，詔參知政事邢抱樸決南京滯獄。
units.en: On guimao day of the fifth month an edict ordered associate state counselor Xing Baopu to decide delayed cases at Nanjing.
units.literal: Fifth month, on guimao day an edict ordered associate state counselor Xing Baopu to decide Nanjing's backlog of cases.

units.zh: 庚戌，朔州威勝軍一百七人叛入宋。
units.en: On gengxu day one hundred seven soldiers of Shuo Prefecture's Weisheng Army defected to Song.
units.literal: On gengxu day one hundred seven men of Shuo Prefecture's Weisheng Army rebelled and entered Song.

units.zh: 六月辛未，如炭山清暑。
units.en: On xinwei day of the sixth month the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
units.literal: Sixth month, on xinwei day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

units.zh: 鐵驪來貢。
units.en: The Iron Li sent tribute.
units.literal: The Iron Li came with tribute.

units.zh: 乙酉，回鶻來貢。
units.en: On yiyou day the Uyghur sent tribute.
units.literal: On yiyou day the Uyghur came with tribute.

units.zh: 己丑，高麗遣使來問起居。
units.en: On jichou day Goryeo sent envoys to inquire after the Emperor's health.
units.literal: On jichou day Goryeo dispatched envoys to come inquire after the Emperor's health.

units.zh: 後至無時。
units.en: Later envoys arrived at irregular intervals.
units.literal: Later arrivals had no fixed time.

units.zh: 秋七月戊午，回鶻等來貢。
units.en: On wuwu day in the seventh autumn month the Uyghur and others sent tribute.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuwu day the Uyghur and others came with tribute.

units.zh: 閏月丁丑，五院部進穴地所得金馬。
units.en: On dingchou day in the intercalary month the Five Courts Division presented gold and horses found while excavating a cave.
units.literal: Intercalary month, on dingchou day the Five Courts Division presented gold and horses obtained from excavating a cave site.

units.zh: 冬十月丙辰，命劉遂教南京神武軍士劍法，賜袍帶錦幣。
units.en: On bingchen day in the tenth winter month Liu Sui was ordered to teach sword fighting to Nanjing's Shenwu Army, and robes, belts, brocade, and coins were granted.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on bingchen day Liu Sui was ordered to teach sword methods to the soldiers of Nanjing's Shenwu Army, and robes, belts, brocade, and coins were granted.

units.zh: 戊午，烏昭度乞內附。
units.en: On wuwu day Wuzhaodu asked to submit and be incorporated.
units.literal: On wuwu day Wuzhaodu begged to come submit internally.

units.zh: 十一月甲戌，詔諸軍官毋非時畋獵妨農。
units.en: On jiaxu day in the eleventh month an edict forbade army officers from hunting out of season and harming the harvest.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on jiaxu day an edict ordered army officers not to hunt out of season and harm farming.

units.zh: 乙酉，奉安景宗及太后石像於乾州。
units.en: On yiyou day stone images of Emperor Jingzong and the Empress Dowager were installed at Qian Prefecture.
units.literal: On yiyou day stone images of Emperor Jingzong and the Empress Dowager were installed at Qian Prefecture.

units.zh: 是月，回鶻阿薩蘭遣使為子求婚，不許。
units.en: That month Arsalan Uyghur sent envoys asking to marry his son into the court; the request was refused.
units.literal: That month, Arsalan Uyghur dispatched envoys to seek marriage for his son; it was not granted.

units.zh: 十二月甲寅，以南京道新定稅法太重，減之。
units.en: On jiayin day in the twelfth month the newly fixed tax law of the Nanjing circuit was reduced because it was too heavy.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on jiayin day because the newly fixed tax law of the Nanjing circuit was too heavy, it was reduced.

units.zh: 甲子，撻凜誘叛酋阿魯敦等六十人斬之，封蘭陵郡王。
units.en: On jiazi day Talin lured rebel chieftains including Arudun, beheaded sixty of them, and was enfeoffed Commandery Prince of Lanling.
units.literal: On jiazi day Talin lured rebel chieftains Arudun and sixty others and beheaded them; he was enfeoffed Commandery Prince of Lanling.

units.zh: 幸南京。
units.en: The court visited Nanjing.
units.literal: Visited Nanjing.

units.zh: 是年，放進士張儉等三人。
units.en: That year jinshi Zhang Jian and two others passed the examinations.
units.literal: That year jinshi Zhang Jian and two others were passed and granted degree.

units.zh: 十五年春正月庚午，幸延芳澱。
units.en: In the fifteenth year, on gengwu day in the first spring month, the court visited Yanfang Marsh.
units.literal: Fifteenth year, spring, first month, on gengwu day visited Yanfang Marsh.

units.zh: 丙子，以河西党項叛，詔韓德威討之。
units.en: On bingzi day an edict ordered Han Dewei to campaign against the Tangut west of the river who had rebelled.
units.literal: On bingzi day because the Tangut west of the river had rebelled, an edict ordered Han Dewei to campaign against them.

units.zh: 庚辰，詔諸道勸民種樹。
units.en: On gengchen day an edict ordered the various circuits to encourage tree planting.
units.literal: On gengchen day an edict ordered the various circuits to encourage the people to plant trees.

units.zh: 癸未，兀惹長武周來降。
units.en: On guiwei day the Wu'er chief Wuzhou surrendered.
units.literal: On guiwei day the Wu'er chief Wuzhou came to surrender.

units.zh: 戊子，女直遣使來貢。
units.en: On wuzi day the Jurchen sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On wuzi day the Jurchen dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 己丑，詔南京決滯囚。
units.en: On jichou day an edict ordered Nanjing to clear its backlog of prisoners.
units.literal: On jichou day an edict ordered Nanjing to decide backlog prisoners.

units.zh: 乙未，免流民稅。
units.en: On yiwei day an edict remitted taxes owed by displaced people.
units.literal: On yiwei day remitted taxes of displaced people.

units.zh: 二月丙申朔，如長春宮。
units.en: On the bingshen new moon of the second month the court visited Changchun Palace.
units.literal: Second month, on bingshen new moon: visited Changchun Palace.

units.zh: 戊戌，勸品部富民出錢以贍貧民。
units.en: On wuxu day wealthy households of the Pinbu division were urged to contribute money to support the poor.
units.literal: On wuxu day the Pinbu division's wealthy households were urged to contribute money to support the poor.

units.zh: 庚子，徙梁門、遂城、泰州、北平民於內地。
units.en: On gengzi day the people of Liangmen, Suicheng, Taizhou, and Beiping were relocated inland.
units.literal: On gengzi day the people of Liangmen, Suicheng, Taizhou, and Beiping were moved to the interior.

units.zh: 丙午，夏國遣使來貢。
units.en: On bingwu day Western Xia sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On bingwu day Western Xia dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 甲寅，問安皇太后。
units.en: On jiayin day the Emperor inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.
units.literal: On jiayin day inquired after the Empress Dowager's health.

units.zh: 丙辰，韓德威奏破党項捷。
units.en: On bingchen day Han Dewei reported victory over the Tangut.
units.literal: On bingchen day Han Dewei memorialized victory in breaking the Tangut.

units.zh: 丁巳，詔品部曠地令民耕種。
units.en: On dingsi day an edict ordered vacant Pinbu land opened to civilian cultivation.
units.literal: On dingsi day an edict ordered vacant land of the Pinbu division given to the people to farm.

units.zh: 三月乙丑朔，党項來貢。
units.en: On the yichou new moon of the third month the Tangut sent tribute.
units.literal: Third month, on yichou new moon: the Tangut came with tribute.

units.zh: 戊辰，募民耕灤州荒地，免其租賦十年。
units.en: On wuchen day civilians were recruited to farm wasteland in Luan Prefecture with tax and corvée remitted for ten years.
units.literal: On wuchen day the people were recruited to farm wasteland in Luan Prefecture, remitting their tax and levies for ten years.

units.zh: 己巳，夏國破宋兵，遣使來告。
units.en: On jisi day Western Xia defeated Song troops and sent envoys to report the victory.
units.literal: On jisi day Western Xia broke Song troops and dispatched envoys to come report.

units.zh: 己卯，封夏國王李繼遷為西平王。
units.en: On jimao day Western Xia King Li Jiqian was enfeoffed King of Xiping.
units.literal: On jimao day Western Xia King Li Jiqian was enfeoffed King of Xiping.

units.zh: 壬午，通括宮分人戶，免南京逋稅及義倉粟。
units.en: On renwu day palace household registers were comprehensively checked and Nanjing's tax arrears and charity-granary grain were remitted.
units.literal: On renwu day palace household registers were comprehensively checked; Nanjing's tax arrears and charity-granary grain were remitted.

units.zh: 甲申，河西党項乞內附。
units.en: On jiashen day the Tangut west of the river asked to submit and be incorporated.
units.literal: On jiashen day the Tangut west of the river begged to come submit internally.

units.zh: 庚寅，兀惹烏昭度以地遠，乞歲時免進鷹、馬、貂皮，詔以生辰、正旦貢如舊，餘免。
units.en: On gengyin day the Wu'er Wuzhaodu, citing the distance of his territory, asked to be exempted from yearly tribute of hawks, horses, and sable pelts; an edict kept birthday and New Year's tribute as before and exempted the rest.
units.literal: On gengyin day the Wu'er Wuzhaodu, because his land was distant, begged to be exempted yearly from presenting hawks, horses, and sable pelts; an edict ordered tribute on the birthday and New Year's Day as before, the rest exempted.

units.zh: 癸巳，宋主炅殂，子恒嗣位。
units.en: On guisi day the Song emperor Zhao Jiong died and his son Zhao Heng succeeded to the throne.
units.literal: On guisi day the Song ruler Jiong died; his son Heng succeeded to the throne.

units.zh: 甲午，皇太妃獻西邊捷。
units.en: On jiawu day the Grand Imperial Consort reported victory on the western frontier.
units.literal: On jiawu day the Grand Imperial Consort presented western frontier victory.

units.zh: 夏四月乙未朔，罷奚五部歲貢摐。
units.en: On the yiwei new moon of the fourth summer month the yearly zheng tribute of the five Xi divisions was abolished.
units.literal: Summer, fourth month, on yiwei new moon: abolished the yearly tribute of zheng from the five Xi divisions.

units.zh: 戊戌，錄囚。
units.en: On wuxu day the court reviewed prisoners.
units.literal: On wuxu day prisoners were reviewed.

units.zh: 壬寅，發義倉粟振南京諸縣民。
units.en: On renyin day charity-granary grain was issued to relieve the people of Nanjing's counties.
units.literal: On renyin day charity-granary grain was issued to relieve the people of Nanjing's various counties.

units.zh: 丙午，廣德軍節度使韓德凝有善政，秩滿，其民請留，從之。
units.en: On bingwu day Guangde Army military commissioner Han Dening, whose benevolent rule the people wished to retain at term's end, was allowed to stay.
units.literal: On bingwu day Guangde Army military commissioner Han Dening had benevolent government; when his term ended the people asked that he remain; it was granted.

units.zh: 己酉，幸南京。
units.en: On jiyou day the court visited Nanjing.
units.literal: On jiyou day visited Nanjing.

units.zh: 丁巳，致奠於太宗皇帝廟。
units.en: On dingsi day the court offered rites at Emperor Taizong's temple.
units.literal: On dingsi day offerings were made at Emperor Taizong's temple.

units.zh: 己未，如炭山清暑。
units.en: On jiwei day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.
units.literal: On jiwei day the court went to Coal Mountain for the summer retreat.

units.zh: 五月甲子朔，日有食之。
units.en: On the jiazi new moon of the fifth month there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: Fifth month, on jiazi new moon: there was a solar eclipse.

units.zh: 己巳，詔平州決滯獄。
units.en: On jisi day an edict ordered Ping Prefecture to clear its backlog of cases.
units.literal: On jisi day an edict ordered Ping Prefecture to decide backlog cases.

units.zh: 是月，敵烈八部殺詳穩以叛，蕭撻凜追擊，獲部族之半。
units.en: That month the eight Jilie divisions killed their xiangwen and rebelled; Xiao Talin pursued them and captured half the tribes.
units.literal: That month, the eight Jilie divisions killed their xiangwen and rebelled; Xiao Talin pursued and struck them, capturing half the tribes.

units.zh: 六月丙申，鐵驪來貢。
units.en: On bingshen day in the sixth month the Iron Li sent tribute.
units.literal: Sixth month, on bingshen day the Iron Li came with tribute.

units.zh: 壬子，夏國遣使來謝封冊。
units.en: On renzi day Western Xia sent envoys to thank the court for the enfeoffment.
units.literal: On renzi day Western Xia dispatched envoys to come thank the enfeoffment and investiture.

units.zh: 秋七月戊辰，党項來貢。
units.en: On wuchen day in the seventh autumn month the Tangut sent tribute.
units.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on wuchen day the Tangut came with tribute.

units.zh: 辛未，禁吐谷渾別部鬻馬於宋。
units.en: On xinwei day the separate Tuyuhun division was forbidden to sell horses to Song.
units.literal: On xinwei day the separate division of the Tuyuhun was forbidden to sell horses to Song.

units.zh: 丙子，高麗遣韓彥敬奉幣吊越國公主之喪。
units.en: On bingzi day Goryeo sent Han Yanjing with gifts to mourn the death of the Princess of Yue.
units.literal: On bingzi day Goryeo dispatched Han Yanjing to present gifts and mourn the death of the Princess of Yue State.

units.zh: 辛卯，詔南京疾決獄訟。
units.en: On xinmao day an edict ordered Nanjing to decide lawsuits quickly.
units.literal: On xinmao day an edict ordered Nanjing to decide prison cases swiftly.

units.zh: 八月丁酉，獵於平地松林，皇太后誡曰：「前聖有言：欲不可縱。
units.en: On dingyou day in the eighth month the court hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest; the Empress Dowager admonished him, saying, "The former sages said that desire must not be indulged.
units.literal: Eighth month, on dingyou day hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest; the Empress Dowager admonished, saying: "The former sages had a saying: desire must not be indulged.

units.zh: 吾兒為天下主，馳騁田獵，萬一有銜橛之變，適遣予憂。
units.en: My son is master of all under Heaven; if you gallop about hunting in the fields and by any chance there is a bit-in-the-mouth mishap, you will only send me grief.
units.literal: My son is master of all under Heaven; if you gallop about hunting in the fields and by any chance there is a bit-in-the-mouth mishap, you will only send me grief.

units.zh: 其深戒之！」
units.en: Take this deeply to heart!"
units.literal: Deeply take warning of this!"

units.zh: 九月丙寅，罷東邊戍卒。
units.en: In the ninth month, on bingyin day, eastern frontier garrison troops were withdrawn.
units.literal: Ninth month, on bingyin day eastern frontier garrison soldiers were abolished.

units.zh: 庚午，幸饒州，致奠太祖廟。
units.en: On gengwu day the court visited Rao Prefecture and offered rites at Emperor Taizu's temple.
units.literal: On gengwu day visited Rao Prefecture and made offerings at Emperor Taizu's temple.

units.zh: 戊子，蕭撻凜奏討阻卜捷。
units.en: On wuzi day Xiao Talin reported victory over the Zubu.
units.literal: On wuzi day Xiao Talin memorialized victory in campaigning against the Zubu.

units.zh: 冬十月壬辰朔，駐蹕駝山，罷奚王諸部貢物。
units.en: On the renchen new moon of the tenth winter month the court encamped at Camel Mountain and abolished tribute from the Xi King and the various tribes.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renchen new moon: encamped at Camel Mountain; tribute goods of the Xi King and the various tribes were abolished.

units.zh: 乙未，賜宿衛時服。
units.en: On yiwei day seasonal clothing was granted to the palace guard.
units.literal: On yiwei day seasonal clothing was granted to the palace guard.

units.zh: 丁酉，禁諸山寺毋濫度僧尼。
units.en: On dingyou day an edict forbade monasteries and mountain temples from ordaining monks and nuns indiscriminately.
units.literal: On dingyou day monasteries and mountain temples were forbidden to indiscriminately ordain monks and nuns.

units.zh: 戊戌，馳東京道魚濼之禁。
units.en: On wuxu day the ban on fishing at Yu Marsh on the Eastern Capital circuit was lifted.
units.literal: On wuxu day the prohibition on fishing at the Tokyo circuit's Yu Marsh was lifted.

units.zh: 戊申，以上京獄訟繁冗，詰其主者。
units.en: On wushen day, because litigation at the Supreme Capital had become excessive, those responsible were called to account.
units.literal: On wushen day because litigation at the Supreme Capital was numerous and redundant, those in charge were called to account.

units.zh: 辛酉，錄囚。
units.en: On xinyou day the court reviewed prisoners.
units.literal: On xinyou day prisoners were reviewed.

units.zh: 十一月壬戌朔，錄囚，丙戌，幸顯州。
units.en: On the renxu new moon of the eleventh month prisoners were reviewed; on bingxu day the court visited Xian Prefecture.
units.literal: Eleventh month, on renxu new moon: prisoners were reviewed; on bingxu day visited Xian Prefecture.

units.zh: 戊子，謁顯陵。
units.en: On wuzi day the court visited Xian Mausoleum.
units.literal: On wuzi day visited Xian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 庚寅，謁乾陵。
units.en: On gengyin day the court visited Qian Mausoleum.
units.literal: On gengyin day visited Qian Mausoleum.

units.zh: 是月，高麗王治薨，侄誦遣王同潁來告。
units.en: That month Goryeo King Wang Zhi died; his nephew Song sent Wang Tongying to report the death.
units.literal: That month, Goryeo King Wang Zhi died; his nephew Song dispatched Wang Tongying to come report.

units.zh: 十二月乙巳，鉤魚土河。
units.en: On yisi day in the twelfth month the court went ice fishing on the Tu River.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on yisi day ice fishing was conducted on the Tu River.

units.zh: 己酉，駐蹕駝山。
units.en: On jiyou day the court encamped at Camel Mountain.
units.literal: On jiyou day encamped at Camel Mountain.

units.zh: 壬子，夏國遣使來貢。
units.en: On renzi day Western Xia sent envoys with tribute.
units.literal: On renzi day Western Xia dispatched envoys to come with tribute.

units.zh: 甲寅，遣使祭高麗王治，詔其侄權知國事。
units.en: On jiayin day envoys were sent to mourn Goryeo King Wang Zhi, and an edict put his nephew in provisional charge of state affairs.
units.literal: On jiayin day envoys were dispatched to sacrifice for Goryeo King Wang Zhi; an edict ordered his nephew to administer state affairs provisionally.

units.zh: 丙辰，錄囚。
units.en: On bingchen day the court reviewed prisoners.
units.literal: On bingchen day prisoners were reviewed.

units.zh: 是年，放進士陳鼎等二人。
units.en: That year jinshi Chen Ding and one other passed the examinations.
units.literal: That year jinshi Chen Ding and one other were passed and granted degree.
